SELECT A.PROD_ID as prodId, A.VDATE as prdVDate, A.MDATE as prdMDate, A.holdDate, B.REG_CODE as prdRegistCode FROM objRec A LEFT JOIN CHB_PRDRESIST_CODE B ON A.PROD_ID = B.PRODID LEFT JOIN CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB C ON (A.PROD_ID = C.PRODID AND A.holdDate = TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(C.HOLD_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') ) WHERE C.PRODID is null
UNION ALL
SELECT tmp3.prodId, tmp3.prdVDate, tmp3.prdMDate, tmp3.holdDate, tmp3.prdRegistCode FROM ( SELECT tmp2.prodId, tmp2.prdVDate, tmp2.prdMDate, tmp2.holdDate, tmp2.prdRegistCode, SUM(tmp2.lateNums) as validateTol FROM ( SELECT tmp1.prodId, tmp1.prdVDate, tmp1.prdMDate, tmp1.holdDate, tmp1.prdRegistCode, CASE WHEN tmp1.STATUS = '03' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END lateNums FROM ( SELECT A.PROD_ID as prodId, A.VDATE as prdVDate, A.MDATE as prdMDate, A.holdDate, B.REG_CODE as prdRegistCode, C.STATUS, ROW_NUMBER() over( partition by A.PROD_ID, C.INDENTIFY_MARK ORDER BY C.UPDATE_TIME DESC) AS investStsNo FROM objRec A LEFT JOIN CHB_PRDRESIST_CODE B ON A.PROD_ID = B.PRODID INNER JOIN CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB C ON (A.PROD_ID = C.PRODID AND A.holdDate = TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(C.HOLD_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') ) ) tmp1 WHERE investStsNo = 1 ) tmp2 GROUP BY tmp2.prodId, tmp2.prdVDate, tmp2.prdMDate, tmp2.holdDate, tmp2.prdRegistCode ) tmp3 WHERE tmp3.validateTol = 0
